root_cause: clearMessages' settle handler unconditionally called appendQueues.delete(key), releasing the slot of a write queued behind it; a later append then started from an empty queue and raced it (read-modify-write), dropping a row.
fix: clearMessages now settles to a no-op and releases the slot only if appendQueues.get(key) === settled, matching the other writers. Return value and aux cleanup unchanged. MessagePatch doc comment corrected: rev 0 is persisted as rev: 0; only negative/non-finite rev is stripped.
tests_added: app/tests/unit/marmot/chatPersistence-clearRace.test.ts: append queued during clear + append after both persist ([b, c])

verification_answers.VQ-1: Yes. New test failed pre-fix (expected [b, c], received [b]; 'c' missing) and passes after the fix.
verification_answers.VQ-2: Yes. Same own-slot check as other writers (appendQueues.get(key) === settled); return value and aux cleanup untouched.
verification_answers.VQ-3: Yes. Full unit suite 230 files / 4725 passed / 1 skipped; tsc --noEmit clean.
verification_answers.VQ-4: Yes. MessagePatch comment corrected to match behaviour (rev 0 persisted as rev: 0; only malformed rev stripped).
